mods.name: Minute Rush
mods.description: A fast multiplayer Minecraft minigame where everyone races to complete the same task.

releases.notes:
Pre-Release number 1. (3/11/2026 - 1)
Download the full `.jar` file (not `sources.jar`) and put it in the mods folder to play it.
Requires Fabric 26.3.

Game inspired from Minute Rush by qmagnet: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/worlds/minute-rush
Description:
A mini-game with 400+ tasks covering a wide range of actions, including crafting, movements and combats.
Each task has maximum of one minute to complete.
The first player to complete the task wins the round.
First to 10 (default) wins the match!
Compete with your friends!

Instructions (all commands require server operator to use):
Use `/minute-rush start` command to start the game.

Other operator commands:
`/minute-rush reset` to reset the match mid-game.
`/minute-rush skip` to skip the task.

`/minute-rush test <category>` to test the tasks by categories.
Categories:
1.  `crafting`
2.  `combat`
3.  `movement`
4.  `interactive`
5.  `basic`
